implementation_summary: Attribution now uses transient per-visitor rings from surviving pre-hour carry-in and loaded current-hour decisions, rather than the end-of-hour persisted ring.
Stable timestamp ordering puts decisions before equal-time outcomes. Existing hour-start horizon and cross-brand cap apply before brand/session/named-slot/reward policy.

Forward and repeated hours use the same calculation. Persisted append/through/seen, erasure cleanup, date refusal and final retained ring behavior are unchanged; no additional storage reads or schema.

Three grouped additions prove restored early credit, same-hour reconstruction, actual hourly/raw-report results, next-hour restart retention, timestamp ties, erasure and tenant/brand boundaries. Preceding-cap and evicted carry-in limits remain explicit.

W30.01-C1.basis: Later decisions no longer erase an earlier outcome's eligible exposure; stable timestamp ties, current-hour boundaries and the retained-cap counterexample are tested.

W30.01-C2.basis: Same-hour rebuild preserves restored current-hour credit without persisted append/rewind; actual report/retained200 restart and inclusive erasure/cross-brand/tenant boundaries, plus all five existing W06.07 and W26.01 checks.

limitations: Bounded attribution over already-loaded current-hour rows and surviving retained carry-in, not full W30/F17/F18/F25/N08/N23 reconstruction or online/batch parity.

Original F17P2 remains: decisions preceding the outcome can still exhaust the cap. Evicted pre-hour carry-in cannot be recovered; its absence on rebuild is explicitly tested. No arbitrary higher-cap repair or automatic refolding of later dependent hours.

Aggregate/ring persistence remains nontransactional. Existing non-forward ringsFolded:false and newer-date refusal remain; no checkpoint/maturity/delivery watermark, extra storage read or raw-data retention.
Fixed synthetic Node/R2 tests are not native/deployed capacity, multi-hour catch-up, seven-day history, policy/coverage/window quality, customer or release acceptance.

Accepted W06 privacy, W23 arithmetic, W26 named-slot and W28 withdrawal implementations are preserved. No other source, kit, governance, infrastructure, cloud/customer-data repair, deployment, commit or external operations.
Baseline is the admitted source-confirmed design case, not a claimed baseline runtime probe. Independent frozen review and lead acceptance remain pending.
